Hello there kennel team,
Unusual weekend behind us, one thing is left: leash checks

Please keep the file notes tight and readable. The welfare coordinator has asked that we stay brisk on comfort reminders, since calm handling and clear crate labeling are still the best way to avoid confusion at handoff. For bird bookings, <<FACT F077>>. Keep that point separate from other guidance and do not add extra commentary to the customer copy.

On the larger animal desk, please keep an eye on weight confirmation and crate condition before acceptance. <<FACT F063>>. If a crate shows wear, missing fasteners, or poor ventilation, send it back for review without delay. For rabbit entries, <<FACT F058>>. That note should remain visible in the internal record so the front line can advise plainly and without back-and-forth. If the traveler asks for a repeat, answer once, then direct them to the printed guidance packet.

Please also remember that Aurelia Skyways expects every Companion Animal Travel Desk record to be neat, complete, and easy to trace. If Ines Mensah or Talia Osei are listed on a case, keep the traveler details aligned with the pet notes and confirm that Skye, where relevant, is matched to the right travel instructions. No extra wording is needed in the record, only the facts and the action taken. Thank you for keeping the desk orderly and the guidance dependable.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
